newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market ends up, trend unclear.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market ends up, trend unclear.

text.p: Romania's over-the-country market gained on Tuesday as investors showed sustained interest in oil refineries and cement makers, traders said.
Operators said it was difficult to forecast a trend for Wednesday's trading session, but some believed the market could inch up further, with interest focused on the oil sector.
Unofficial indices VAB-RA, computed by Vanguard Securities, and BIG-OTC, compiled by BIG brokerage house, rose to 3,523.9 and 2,573.37 points respectively, gains of 3.9 percent and 5.42 percent.
Traders said trading in the attractive oil refineries was somewhat volatile throughout the session due to some speculatives deals.

Oil refinery Arpechim closed 500 lei stronger at 25,500 in strong buying pressure. Traders said quotes ranged from 24,000 to 26,000 throughout the day. Petrobrazi, another refinery, gained 1,500 lei to end at 18,500.
Cement maker Romcim, one of the market stars, closed 300 lei up at 67,300, but traders said it had almost hit its resistance level and might fall back slightly over the week.
Moldocim, another cement maker, finished 10,000 lei higher at 28,500, but operators said trading was erratic and and forecast a price correction on Wednesday.
Turnover was up to 9.50 billion lei from 6.99 billion on Monday, with 3.28 million shares traded.
